The road runs from the wall (z 0) to the far end (z 100) in three columns (core.js COLS: L · M · R). The squad (`squad` 豆兵 at the start) fires on its own up the column it stands in: `shot.rate` + `perSoldier` a 豆兵 thrown a second (to `max`), at `shot.speed` z/s, the whole attack `dps` a 豆兵 a second × the tier's `power` (`tiers`: 豆兵 → 纸甲兵 → 铜人). `belt`: the side columns' things riding down at `speed` z/s, laid by `lines` (`col`, `from` + k·`every` to `until`): `cards` cycled one a row — a card's `n` (red below 0) goes up `step` a hit and pays at its `cap`, or at the line if the squad stands in its column — and `wall`s with `hp` that shield what is behind (`gives: tier` lifts the squad a tier). `waves`: the 兽潮 down the middle, each at `t` s, [[beast, n]…] (the last kind the front rank), at `speed` z/s; at the wall `breach` beasts a second break on it. `boss`: walks down from `stand` at `speed`; its `charge` every `every` s down the squad's column, shown `warn` s ahead, knocks `kill` of the squad aside unless it moved off; at the wall it crushes `crush` a second. `wall`: the 山门's hp; `stars`: [★★★, ★★] by the share of it left, ★★★ inside `par` s. `press`: the bots' turn to the middle. `hui`: the 回 the level belongs to — it sends only beasts met by then.

beasts._about: power: how many 豆兵 one beast takes. size: its drawn height (px) at the wall; it shrinks up the road. frames: 守墙关's painted frames, shared (scripts/games/shouqiang/art/<id>-<frame>.webp); `art: "sadou"` = 撒豆成兵's own (the 蠪侄). A boss has a `name` (the HP bar) and `face`. `fly`: it bobs. The beasts a level may send are the book's by its `hui` (creatures.json `hui` ≤ the level's; tests/game-sadoushou.test.mjs).
beasts._people: 第一回's 收租 daydream (levels `zaotai`, 2026-10-22): people, not beasts — the 马家 men down the middle of 小满's daydream on the floor. `art: "sadoushou"` = this kit's own (scripts/games/sadoushou/art/); `pose` names the frame a 大妖 shows while it gathers itself (`warn`) and charges (`rush`). They are the book's own (第一回: 马三 · 马小宝 · 马家的家丁) — never a creatures.json row.

jieyinSets._about: 结印's move sets (Hanli 10-22, 「可以」): a level's `jieyin.set` names one — the STORY levels play `simple` (飞剑 4 s · 火弹 7 s after 古六's lesson, as he played and accepted 10-22), the 游戏厅's ladder `full` (the ten 手势斗法 moves: four 小招 from the start, five 法术 and the 大招 after 古六). Unnamed: a story level `simple`, else `full`. `only` keeps just those ids of the set (守灶台, the game's first 结印: 飞剑 alone). `from`: the save's marks first; `secs`: what it does here.

jieyinDock._about: Where 结印's button and gesture frame stand on this board (games/jieyin/helper.js offerSeals `dock`), every level alike — top-left, under the top bar, over the backdrop beyond the road's far end (Hanli 10-22, of 守灶台: 「结印的框会挡住画面, 可以上面一点吗?」): the bottom-left corner covered the squad, the 灶台 and the left column's cards. `w`: the frame's width, a share of the field — narrow enough to stay off the middle column, where the 大妖 step out.

jieyin._about: 结印 at the camera (Hanli 10-21: 「把结印放到现有的塔防类游戏中」; the dock is games/jieyin/helper.js, only where a camera is). card.zh: 那张卡打大了，站过去接住！
card.en: That card's grown — stand under it to take it!

red.zh: 红卡别接，打到正的再说。
red.en: Don't take a red card — shoot it positive first.

wall.zh: 石墙后面有好东西，打碎它！
wall.en: Something good behind that stone wall — break it!

tier.en: New armour — the soldiers hit harder!

low.en: The gate won't hold much longer!

boss.en: The great beast is out! Everyone, at it!

charge.zh: 它要冲你这一列了，换一列！
charge.en: It's charging your column — move to another!

won.en: We held! Well done, bean soldiers.

lost.zh: 山门破了……差一点，再来一把豆子。
lost.en: The gate broke… so close. Another handful of beans.

en.horde: boars and zheng and qiuyu and qique
